settings.title: Settings
settings.onlyTranslationHint: Do not save original lyrics when a translation is available.
settings.removeEmptyLyricLinesHint: Clean empty lines after plugin lyrics are encoded.
settings.lyricLineOrderHint: Each lyric line is written in this order, top to bottom. Drag the handle to reorder.
settings.cleanupKeywordsHint: One keyword per line. Matching metadata/credit lines are removed during lyric formatting.
settings.ignoreShortAudioHint: Skip audio files that are 60 seconds or shorter while scanning.
settings.lyricIndexHint: Include lyric text when searching the local library.
settings.artistPosterFolderHint: Use exact artist-name image files as fallback artwork in the Artists view.
settings.themeModeHint: Follow the Windows app mode, or force light or dark.
settings.replayGainTargetHint: Gains are calculated relative to this loudness. Range: -30 to 0 LUFS, default -18.
settings.exportConfigHint: Save settings, artist split rules and plugin preferences as a JSON backup.
settings.importConfigHint: Restore a previously exported JSON backup. The current configuration is replaced.
settings.groupMembersHint: Drag to reorder the group; switches control field visibility.
settings.aboutDescription: Local music tag and lyrics editor
settings.replayGainPeakHint: Sample peak is faster; true peak measures inter-sample peaks and takes longer
settings.logsFileHint: Logs are saved automatically, rotated at 5 MiB, with 5 archived files retained

artistSplit.artistSeparatorHint: Used to join multiple ARTIST values while scanning tags. Rescan folders after changing it.
artistSplit.enabledHint: List songs with multiple artists under each artist separately.
artistSplit.builtinSeparatorsHint: Choose the separators used in artist names.
artistSplit.customSeparatorsHint: Type a separator and press Enter or Add. Spaces are kept when they are part of the separator.
artistSplit.customSeparatorsPlaceholder: Add separators such as + or with
artistSplit.customNoSplitHint: Type a complete artist name and press Enter or Add.
artistSplit.customNoSplitPlaceholder: Add artist names that must stay intact
artistSplit.duplicateBuiltin: That entry already exists in the built-in list
